hero_title: See a problem? Help solve it.
hero_subtitle: Report local community challenges with a photo, voice, or text. Sahyog connects public problems with universities and industry to turn issues into real solutions.
step1_desc: Upload a photo of the problem with optional text or voice in your language.
step2_desc: Multimodal AI analyzes visual damage, priority, and required engineering domain.
step3_desc: Intelligently matches the challenge with universities and industry partners.
step4_desc: Track real-world collaborative progress from design to full field resolution.
impact_sub: Turning citizen observations into structured engineering action.
form_subtitle: A photo is required. You can also add your voice note or a text description.
upload_photo_sub: JPG, PNG or WebP • Max 10 MB
describe_placeholder: What is happening here? (e.g. Large potholes near village school)
